	<h:head>
		<h:title>Registration Form</h:title>
		<model>
			<instance>
				<data xmlns:jrm="http://dev.commcarehq.org/jr/xforms" xmlns="http://openrosa.org/formdesigner/5f79ab84-240d-416f-abf4-1607759d2675" uiVersion="1" version="3" name="Registration Form">
					<head_name />
					<members />
					<village />
					<visit_date />
					<notes>
						<remark />
					</notes>
					<members_plus_one />
				</data>
			</instance>
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/head_name" nodeset="/data/head_name" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/members" nodeset="/data/members" type="xsd:int" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/village" nodeset="/data/village" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/visit_date" nodeset="/data/visit_date" type="xsd:date" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/notes" nodeset="/data/notes" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/notes/remark" nodeset="/data/notes/remark" type="xsd:string" />
			<bind vellum:nodeset="#form/members_plus_one" nodeset="/data/members_plus_one" vellum:calculate="#form/members + 1" calculate="/data/members + 1" />
			<itext>
				<translation lang="en" default="">
					<text id="head_name-label">
						<value>Head of household</value>
					</text>
					<text id="members-label">
						<value>Members</value>
					</text>
					<text id="village-label">
						<value>Village</value>
					</text>
					<text id="village-north-label">
						<value>North</value>
					</text>
					<text id="village-south-label">
						<value>South</value>
					</text>
					<text id="visit_date-label">
						<value>Visit date</value>
					</text>
					<text id="notes-label">
						<value>Notes</value>
					</text>
					<text id="notes/remark-label">
						<value>Remark</value>
					</text>
				</translation>
			</itext>
		</model>
	</h:head>
	<h:body>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/head_name" ref="/data/head_name">
			<label ref="jr:itext('head_name-label')" />
		</input>
		<input vellum:ref="#form/members" ref="/data/members">
			<label ref="jr:itext('members-label')" />
		</input>
		<select1 vellum:ref="#form/village" ref="/data/village">
			<label ref="jr:itext('village-label')" />
			<item>
				<label ref="jr:itext('village-north-label')" />

			</item>
			<item>
				<label ref="jr:itext('village-south-label')" />

			</item>
		</select1>

		</input>

			<input vellum:ref="#form/notes/remark" ref="/data/notes/remark">
				<label ref="jr:itext('notes/remark-label')" />
			</input>
		</group>
	</h:body>
